items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The Videorc design tokens in light and dark: the window coats, floating glass tiers, three text tiers, semantic tones, radius tiers and the desktop scale, plus the glass-chip, glass-float, chrome-* and tone-* utilities and the base layer. Every videorc/ui component depends on it.

dark.chrome-fill-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--chrome-fill-hi), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--chrome-fill-lo), 0 1px 3px var(--chrome-fill-drop), 0 0 0 1px var(--chrome-edge)
dark.chrome-led-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--chrome-led-hi), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--chrome-led-lo), 0 1px 3px var(--chrome-led-drop), 0 0 0 1px var(--chrome-edge)

light.chrome-fill-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--chrome-fill-hi), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--chrome-fill-lo), 0 1px 3px var(--chrome-fill-drop), 0 0 0 1px var(--chrome-edge)
light.chrome-led-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--chrome-led-hi), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--chrome-led-lo), 0 1px 3px var(--chrome-led-drop), 0 0 0 1px var(--chrome-edge)

theme.font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

@utility glass-chip-tinted.background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in oklch, var(--chip-tone) var(--chip-tint-top), transparent), color-mix(in oklch, var(--chip-tone) var(--chip-tint-bottom), transparent))

@utility glass-dot.box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--chip-tone, var(--muted-foreground)) 22%, transparent), 0 0 8px color-mix(in oklch, var(--chip-tone, var(--muted-foreground)) var(--chip-dot-glow), transparent)

@utility chrome-row-live.background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--chrome-row-edge-stops)), linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--chrome-row-live-top), var(--chrome-row-live-bottom)), linear-gradient(var(--glass-solid), var(--glass-solid))

&:hover:not(:disabled).background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--chrome-row-edge-stops)), linear-gradient(var(--chrome-row-lift), var(--chrome-row-lift)), linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--chrome-row-live-top), var(--chrome-row-live-bottom)), linear-gradient(var(--glass-solid), var(--glass-solid))

@utility chrome-row-member.background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--chrome-row-member-top), var(--chrome-row-member-bottom)), linear-gradient(var(--glass-solid), var(--glass-solid))

&:hover:not(:disabled).background-image: linear-gradient(var(--chrome-row-lift), var(--chrome-row-lift)), linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--chrome-row-member-top), var(--chrome-row-member-bottom)), linear-gradient(var(--glass-solid), var(--glass-solid))

items.name: desktop
items.title: Desktop base
items.description: How a desktop app's chrome behaves: chrome text does not select, the arrow is the pointer and the window does not rubber-band. Add it to an Electron or Tauri app; leave it out of a website.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The semantic icon set: every component asks for a meaning (SourcesIcon, AlertIcon, RecordIcon), never a glyph, so a set is swapped in one file. Phosphor underneath.

items.name: accelerator
items.title: Accelerator
items.description: Parses Electron accelerators (CmdOrCtrl+Shift+J) and prints them per platform: ⇧⌘J on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+J elsewhere, with aria-keyshortcuts to match.

items.name: platform
items.title: Platform
items.description: Platform awareness for copy and key glyphs: the current platform from the app, <html data-platform> or the user agent, shortcut labels, the command modifier, and OS names such as Finder and Trash.

items.name: modal-open
items.title: Modal open
items.description: One answer to "is something modal open?": a dialog, alert, menu or open select. Global keys ask it before acting so they never fire from under a popup.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: True when the system asks to reduce motion, plus smoothScrollBehavior() for script-driven scrolls.

items.name: use-theme-toggle
items.title: useThemeToggle
items.description: Toggles light and dark with next-themes and the D key, never from a field or under a popup. Flipping back to the computer's own look returns to System.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Desktop-sized buttons on Base UI: a polished chrome default, a glass-chip secondary, ghost, outline, destructive, link, and the record LED that lights while a session runs.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn(): clsx and tailwind-merge, taught Videorc's desktop sizes, type tokens and radius tiers so a call site's class always overrides a component's.

items.name: field-context
items.title: Field Context
items.description: The wiring that lets a Field name and describe its control: the FieldLabel points at the first control a label can name, other controls take the label through aria-labelledby, and every FieldDescription describes them. Form controls read it through its hooks.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The 14 px medium label for a control. It dims beside a disabled control and keeps the desktop's arrow cursor.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field at the 28 px desktop control height on Base UI's Input, 14 px at every width. Inside a Field, its label names it and its descriptions describe it.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content, at 14 px on the chip radius. Inside a Field, its label names it and its descriptions describe it.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: One 28 px field with icons, text and compact buttons inside it, with its focus and invalid rings drawn around the whole group.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Labels, descriptions and errors for a form control, plus SettingsRow and the grouped settings list. A Field names and describes its control with no ids to wire.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 16 px checkbox on Base UI that wears the chrome fill when checked or indeterminate, with a dash for the mixed state.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: The one control for a boolean, on Base UI: a chrome-fill track when on, with a chrome-bead knob that turns to the inverse bead.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider on Base UI with a chrome-fill range and chrome-bead thumbs. Its name and spoken value go on the thumbs, and inside a Field it takes the FieldLabel.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button on Base UI at the 28 px desktop height. Pressed wears the chrome plate, the same material as a selected segment and an active tab.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Filter chips on Base UI: array values and multiple, pressed items on the chrome plate, named by a Field's label. Items sit apart, wrap, or join into one outlined strip.

items.name: tabs-variants
items.title: Tabs Variants
items.description: The glass segmented track and segment shared by Tabs and SegmentedControl, in a module with no Base UI import so a segmented control costs the first bundle nothing.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch a view on Base UI. The default list is the glass segmented track with the active tab as a chrome plate, the line variant underlines it, and a Field's label names the list.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Pick one of 2–4 exclusive options on the glass Tabs track: a radio group with roving focus and one tab stop, manual activation for heavy changes, icon options with tooltips, and a disabled state that says why.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: One determinate bar on Base UI: a 6 px round track with the chrome fill, with an optional label and value above it.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Videorc's key chip: a glass keycap with a bright top edge and a dark bottom edge, which takes the button's own ink inside a filled button.

items.name: shortcut-keys
items.title: Shortcut Keys
items.description: The one way to show a shortcut: takes an Electron accelerator and prints it the way the platform's menus do (⇧⌘J on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+J elsewhere), as a keycap or as quiet status bar text.

items.name: shortcut-tooltip
items.title: Shortcut Tooltip
items.description: A control's tooltip with its bound shortcut as one keycap. It wraps the control, so the tooltip never touches the control's own attributes.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: shadcn's Recharts wrapper on Videorc's tokens: series stay neutral unless their colour means something, and the tooltip floats on the popup glass.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A flush inline status row on the row radius: default, quiet, locked, success, warning and destructive tones, each with its own icon. Only destructive is an assertive alert; every other tone is a polite status.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Glass chips for status, tags and counts on the 7 px tag radius. Status chips keep their text monochrome and glow their tone in a dot; destructive and live tint the glass, and chrome and plate wear the chrome finish.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round picture of a chat author or a channel on Base UI's Avatar, with initials as the fallback, three sizes, a status badge and an overlapping group.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state in words only: short muted text, centred, with an optional 14 px title and an action. No media tile, no illustration and no dashed box.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A muted placeholder that pulses where content is loading, on the 8 px row radius.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The one spinner for work in flight, on the icon set's SpinnerIcon. It is a status named Loading unless it sits beside its own words, and takes its size from its slot.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A 1 px hairline between groups, horizontal or vertical, on Base UI's Separator.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A native scroller on Base UI's Scroll Area with a thumb-only scrollbar that shows while scrolling, like macOS overlay scrollbars, on the theme's scrollbar tokens. A viewport class takes a height cap.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that open in place on Base UI's Accordion, in a bordered group on the row radius, with one or several items open and a 150 ms height ease.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One section that opens and closes under its trigger, on Base UI's Collapsible. Unstyled, so the trigger is whatever control fits.

items.name: info-tooltip
items.title: Info Tooltip
items.description: Explains a chip, a dot or a short status word on hover and on keyboard focus. A focusable wrapper is the trigger, and the text stays in the DOM as its description.

items.name: disabled-reason
items.title: Disabled Reason
items.description: Says why a control is disabled, on hover and on keyboard focus: a focusable wrapper with a tooltip and aria-describedby, or the item itself in a menu or select.

items.name: chrome-row
items.title: Chrome Row
items.description: The class names for the Stream Manager's chrome rows: the chrome plate on the row that is on stream and the quieter plate with a member-hue edge on a member's row.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for a control on the tooltip tier of the float glass, never an inverted pill. It waits 600 ms for a deliberate hover, and its neighbours under one provider then open at once.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel for a short task on the popup tier of the float glass, fading and scaling from 0.98. An Anchor part lines it up with something other than its trigger.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview of what a link points at, on hover or focus, on the popup tier of the float glass. Base UI's Preview Card under shadcn's name.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions from a button on the popup tier of the float glass: 28 px items, a destructive variant, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus. It keeps the wheel from reaching what sits behind it.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu at the pointer on right-click or long press, with Dropdown Menu's popup tier and 28 px items. It keeps the wheel from reaching what sits behind it.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one value from a list: a 28 px trigger (24 px in dense rows) and a list on the popup tier of the float glass. Inside a Field, its label names it; the wheel stops at the list.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal on the dialog tier of the float glass in four widths (sm, md, lg, xl), with a DialogBody that scrolls between a header and a footer that stay put, and no backdrop blur.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: The question before something destructive, on Dialog's surface and widths: no close button, Cancel focused on open, and Escape as the safe answer. The action leaves closing to its owner.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list on cmdk at the ⌘K palette scale: a borderless 18 px search field, 40 px rows and a footer. It paints no coat, and CommandDialog wraps its children in Command.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Toasts on sonner: every toast is the same neutral float glass, a type colours its 16 px icon only, and each one has a close button.

items.name: pane
items.title: Pane
items.description: The flush column every page lives in. A 40 px toolbar with the page title on the window's drag band, a body that's the only thing that scrolls, and a strip pinned under the toolbar for tabs or filters.

items.name: page
items.title: Page
items.description: The page vocabulary under a pane's toolbar. A flush intro line, the config grid of sections in one column or two, the picture gallery and the plain stack, with no page column, so every page fills its pane edge to edge.

items.name: page-tabs
items.title: Page Tabs
items.description: A page with tabs. One segmented tab list pinned in a strip under the toolbar, and only the region under it scrolls. The selected tab is the caller's, so the app can remember it and open a named tab from a link.

items.name: panel-section
items.title: Panel Section
items.description: The flush section every pane is built from. A 13 px header as an h2, a 12 px description, an action on the title line, 16 px of padding and a hairline to the next section, with no box around it.

items.name: section-label
items.title: Section Label
items.description: The small name over a group of rows or fields, 11 px at 600 in the tertiary tier. One recipe for the sidebar's groups, a grouped list's label and a block of fields.

items.name: list-row
items.title: List Row
items.description: The one row for every icon, title and meta list, and the inset grouped list it sits in. 32 px rows split by hairlines, facts unless they say otherwise, with a whole-row button or a stretched title button when a row acts.

items.name: navigable-row
items.title: Navigable Row
items.description: A fact row of icon, label and value. When the value's home is another page, the row becomes a button with a chevron that jumps there, and a hint lists the facts a short value stands for.

items.name: window-frame
items.title: Window Frame
items.description: The frame of a single-pane window and its header row. The content coat over the window coat, and a 40 px header that shares its line with the macOS traffic lights, carries the window's title and drags the window.

items.name: status-bar
items.title: Status Bar
items.description: The window's 26 px status bar. The session state on the left, and quiet shortcut hints on the right that stay clickable, each pressed while the window it opens is open.

items.name: status-bar-action
items.title: Status Bar Action
items.description: One action in a status bar. An icon, a word or both, with its shortcut, named for assistive tech and on hover by a tooltip, never a native title. It can be a toggle, or a menu's trigger.

items.name: pin-window-button
items.title: Pin Window Button
items.description: Keep on top, the pin every detached window shares. One name in every window, a filled pin while the window stays over other apps, a pressed state a screen reader hears, and a header or a status-bar look.

items.name: chrome-ground
items.title: Chrome Ground
items.description: The frosted still under every Videorc window, black with silver streaks in dark and porcelain with graphite streaks in light. Sized to the display, swapped by the theme class, and never filtered or animated.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: The light and dark switch. A ghost icon button with D as its shortcut, shown in its tooltip; a flip back to the computer's own look returns to System.

items.name: error-boundary
items.title: Error Boundary
items.description: The one render-crash boundary. Its fallback draws what it caught and gets a reset that renders the children again, so a crash stays in its page and the window keeps a way back.

items.name: status-word
items.title: Status Word
items.description: The status vocabulary StatusBadge and StatusDot share: five tones (good, warn, error, live, neutral) and their tone utilities, and a guard that a status says a sentence-case word, never a raw machine value. A raw value throws under test and logs in development.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: The status pill: a round 22 px glass chip with monochrome words and the tone glowing in its dot or leading icon. A failure or an on-air session tints the whole chip.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: Ambient status: the glass dot in its tone, optionally pulsing, beside a quiet monochrome label. It replaces a loud header badge.

items.name: media-card
items.title: Media Card
items.description: A card for an object with a picture: the row radius, a 4% fill, a hairline and no shadow. The one in use wears the chrome plate, and render puts the look on a button or a link.

items.name: kebab-menu
items.title: Kebab Menu
items.description: The ⋯ menu for an item's low-frequency actions: one item list grouped by hairlines, the destructive item last, keys on the right, disabled reasons, a busy spinner, and a trigger that can wait for its row's hover.

items.name: kebab-context-menu
items.title: Kebab Context Menu
items.description: The right-click twin of a row's ⋯ menu, built from the same item list so the two menus can never disagree.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: The one recipe for a destructive confirmation over AlertDialog: a "Verb object?" title, one sentence on what is lost, a focused ghost Cancel and a verb + object answer. Controlled, so the owner closes it once an async action settles.

items.name: lock-alert
items.title: Lock Alert
items.description: Why the controls under it are off: a lock, the reason in one line and at most one action (Sign in or View Premium), resolved by your app. With SessionLockAlert and OfflineAlert for the recording, live and reconnecting locks.

items.name: power-slider
items.title: Power Slider
items.description: A labelled slider for one engine setting: the value with its unit or a typed number, a reset to the default, marks under the track, and a live preview apart from the commit. Its value math is a pure lib beside it.

items.name: device-picker
items.title: Device Picker
items.description: The one picker for a screen, window, camera or microphone: a popover list with words for every state (finding, none found, not found, needs permission), an optional search, and screens and windows under their own headings.

items.name: fader
items.title: Fader
items.description: audiocn's volume fader in decibels, restyled for Videorc: a chrome-fill range and a chrome-bead thumb, with tapers, detents, a scale, reset and an editable value. Forked from audiocn (MIT).

items.name: parameter-slider
items.title: Parameter Slider
items.description: audiocn's labelled slider with a numeric input, unit, marks and reset, restyled for Videorc: a chrome-fill range and a chrome-bead thumb. Forked from audiocn (MIT).
